mapper.sql: SELECT r.round_id, r.round_year, r.quarter, r.status, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at, r.submitted_by, r.submitted_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM improvement m WHERE m.round_id = r.round_id AND NOT (m.origin = 'ROUND_SUBMIT' AND m.action_result = 'PLANNED' AND m.closed_yn = 'N' AND m.action_status IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evidence e WHERE e.owner_type = 'IMPROVEMENT' AND e.owner_id = m.improvement_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_note c WHERE c.target_type = 'IMPROVEMENT' AND c.target_id = m.improvement_id))) AS improvement_count, COUNT(i.round_item_id) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.excluded_yn = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS excluded_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.excluded_yn = 'N' AND i.no_reply_yn = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS no_reply_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.excluded_yn = 'N' AND i.assignee_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assigned_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.excluded_yn = 'N' AND i.no_reply_yn = 'N' AND i.submit_status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'CONFIRMED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS submitted_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.excluded_yn = 'N' AND i.no_reply_yn = 'N' AND i.submit_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_count FROM audit_round r LEFT JOIN round_item i ON i.round_id = r.round_id
GROUP BY r.round_id, r.round_year, r.quarter, r.status, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at, r.submitted_by, r.submitted_at
mapper.select:
WHERE r.status IN #{s}
ORDER BY r.round_year DESC, r.quarter DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_round (round_year, quarter, status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{roundYear}, #{quarter}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: i.round_item_id, i.round_id, i.checklist_item_id, i.team_code, i.assignee_id, i.request_material, i.sample_size, i.no_reply_yn, i.excluded_yn, i.exclude_reason, i.submit_status, i.inspection_result, i.inspection_detail, i.remark1, i.action_plan, i.planned_date, i.submitted_by, i.submitted_at, i.review_comment, i.reviewed_by, i.reviewed_at, i.created_at, i.updated_by, i.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence e WHERE e.owner_type = 'ROUND_ITEM' AND e.owner_id = i.round_item_id AND e.deleted_yn = 'N') AS evidence_count, c.seq_no, c.audit_area, c.audit_item, c.item_detail, c.audit_period, c.regulation, t.team_name, u.user_name AS assignee_name
FROM round_item i JOIN checklist_item c ON c.item_id = i.checklist_item_id LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_code = i.team_code LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = i.assignee_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , r.round_year, r.quarter
JOIN audit_round r ON r.round_id = i.round_id WHERE r.round_year < #{year} OR (r.round_year = #{year} AND r.quarter < #{quarter}) ORDER BY r.round_year DESC, r.quarter DESC, c.seq_no

SELECT , r.round_year, r.quarter, r.status AS round_status
JOIN audit_round r ON r.round_id = i.round_id WHERE i.assignee_id = #{userId} AND i.excluded_yn = 'N' AND r.status <> 'DONE' ORDER BY r.round_year DESC, r.quarter DESC, c.seq_no

SELECT , r.round_year, r.quarter, r.status AS round_status
JOIN audit_round r ON r.round_id = i.round_id WHERE c.seq_no = #{seqNo} AND (r.round_year < #{year} OR (r.round_year = #{year} AND r.quarter < #{quarter})) ORDER BY r.round_year DESC, r.quarter DESC

SELECT , r.round_year, r.quarter, r.status AS round_status
JOIN audit_round r ON r.round_id = i.round_id WHERE c.seq_no = #{seqNo} ORDER BY r.round_year DESC, r.quarter DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE round_item SET inspection_result = #{inspectionResult}, inspection_detail = #{inspectionDetail}, remark1 = #{remark1}, action_plan = #{actionPlan}, planned_date = #{plannedDate}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE round_item_id = #{roundItemId}

UPDATE round_item SET submit_status = #{submitStatus}, submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE round_item_id = #{roundItemId}

UPDATE round_item SET submit_status = #{submitStatus}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE round_item_id = #{roundItemId}

UPDATE audit_round SET status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_by = #{submittedBy}, updated_at = #{submittedAt} WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND status = 'REVIEW'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO round_item (round_id, checklist_item_id, team_code, assignee_id, request_material, sample_size, no_reply_yn, excluded_yn, exclude_reason, submit_status, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{roundId}, #{checklistItemId}, #{teamCode}, #{assigneeId}, #{requestMaterial}, #{sampleSize}, #{noReplyYn}, #{excludedYn}, #{excludeReason}, #{submitStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE round_item SET team_code = #{teamCode}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, request_material = #{requestMaterial}, sample_size = #{sampleSize}, no_reply_yn = #{noReplyYn}, excluded_yn = #{excludedYn}, exclude_reason = #{excludeReason}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE round_item_id = #{roundItemId}
